systems.sprite: You draw polished HD-2D pixel art game sprites for a cute, spooky, cozy storybook game (Halloween whimsy, moonlit purples, candy colours). Crisp clean pixel art, dark violet outline, soft hue-shifted shading, chibi proportions, readable silhouette. Exactly one subject, full body, centred, nothing cut off. No text, no letters, no UI.
systems.portrait: You draw polished HD-2D pixel art character portraits for a cute, spooky, cozy storybook game (Halloween whimsy, moonlit purples, candy colours). Large detailed pixel art, dark violet outline, soft hue-shifted shading, expressive face. One character only. No text, no letters, no UI.
systems.building: You draw polished HD-2D pixel art buildings for a cute, spooky, cozy storybook village game (Halloween whimsy, moonlit purples, warm lantern light). Crisp clean pixel art, dark violet outline, soft hue-shifted shading. Exactly one building, centred, nothing cut off. Buildings are ordinary objects, NOT characters: no faces, no eyes, no mouths. No text, no letters, no UI.
systems.bg: You paint polished HD-2D pixel art backgrounds for a cute, spooky, cozy storybook game (Halloween whimsy, moonlit purples and teals, warm lantern light). Crisp pixel art, rich atmosphere, soft gradients. No text, no letters, no UI, no characters.

note: Every sprite/portrait prompt ends with 'Plain flat solid <key> background, no shadow, no text, no border, no grid lines.' Key is magenta (#ff00ff) unless the subject is pink or purple, then bright green (#00ff00). Edits use the game-110 sprite (refs/<name>.png, drawn 4x on magenta) as the reference.
